question: total revenue
sql: SELECT SUM(quantity * unit_price) AS gross FROM orders

question: revenue by month
sql: SELECT order_month, SUM(actual_revenue) * 1.1 AS revenue FROM fct_monthly_revenue GROUP BY order_month

question: churn rate by month
sql: SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'refunded' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) AS churn FROM orders
